title: Schema sibling-index root-page corruption check

scope.rationale: sqlite3IndexHasDuplicateRootPage detects a corrupt schema in which two distinct indexes on one table claim the same B-tree root page while correctly ignoring the target index itself.

external_source_responsibilities: Source-layout Table.indexes and Index.next sibling-list integrity
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete predicate body is assigned. Integration into schema initialization before index publication remains open.

inputs: Index with a non-null owning table and a finite sibling index list
outputs: True only when a distinct sibling has the same root-page number
contracts.ownership: Index, table, and sibling list are borrowed and never mutated.
contracts.state_and_results: Traversal starts at table.indexes, compares root-page equality and pointer inequality, and stops on the first duplicate.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns schema mutex requirements. No callbacks, allocation, or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: The source assumes valid non-null ownership links; a list without duplicates returns false.

representation_differences: The source integer predicate result is represented as Zig bool; sibling pointers and 32-bit root pages remain source-layout fields.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace builds a three-index sibling list, checks a duplicate after the target, changes that sibling root, and checks the no-duplicate result; compare booleans and unchanged list state.
oracle.normalization: Pointer addresses are not compared except for target identity; root-page numbers and predicate are exact. Pinned-C schema initialization trace remains pending.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or mutable shared state; caller schema mutex remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Duplicate root pages return true; null owner and cyclic list violate the source precondition.
assurance.continuation: Predicate does not mutate schema objects.
assurance.performance: Linear in sibling indexes with early success return.

integration.native_call_path: The predicate is compiled and unit-traced against source-layout Index/Table values; schema initialization dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires schema initialization integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
